title: Sellers Were Already Leaving Before the First Warehouse Burned
subtitle: Liquidations of online traders rose while registrations collapsed, producing the first contraction in the number of companies trading online since 2021.

source.name: Russian company registry data on online trade, first half of 2026

data.label: Liquidations
data.annotation: 76,400 companies and sellers wound up in six months.

data.label: New registrations
data.annotation: Only 58,200 new sellers registered, far fewer than the number leaving.

data.label: Active companies
data.annotation: The stock fell to 456,700, the first decline in the sector since 2021.

supportingFacts.label: Liquidations exceeded registrations by more than eighteen thousand companies in six months.
Sellers with turnover up to 100,000 rubles a month, expected to exit as commissions rose.

metadata.keyFinding: The number of companies trading online fell for the first time since 2021.
